name: Dumbbell Bench Pullover
instructions: Lie across or along a flat bench holding one dumbbell with both hands over your chest, arms nearly straight.
Take a breath and lower the dumbbell in an arc back over your head until you feel a stretch in your lats.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows and your ribs down.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest using your lats.
Keep your hips low and your core braced.
cues: Pull with the lats, not the arms
longevityNotes: Pulling strength balances all the forward-reaching of daily life and protects the shoulders and upper back. A strong back is one of the best predictors of staying active and independent.
overview: A lying dumbbell pullover that stretches and loads the lats and chest through a long overhead arc.

commonMistakes: Letting the weight drop behind the head
Bending the elbows into a triceps extension
safetyNotes: Use a moderate weight and keep a firm grip on the dumbbell; stop at the stretch, not past it.
